summary: The Backrooms is a persistent multiplayer survival RPG across Level 0, a social hub and lore destinations, with a solo tutorial. Shared player behaviors and place simulations combine authored scenes with generated spaces; player saves hold progression, gear, quests and homes. Level 31 adds a roller rink reached through Level 2, with skating handled in the common player movement update.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0/Lobby maze; sim lays ecology, routes, landmarks, Christmas Area and stair anomalies.
places/bonus (3D) - shared vaporwave mall with simulated staff, shops, directory, arcade, payphones and player-home kiosk; Bonus Line is separate.
places/intake + places/tutorial0 (3D; tutorial0 solo ephemeral) - character creation/waking and staged tutorial route; HALOGEN handoff seeds Dina's lead.
places/level01 (3D) - Zenith Station: station, breach, doors, bots, hazards and recorder quest.

places/level1, level2, level02, level21, level3, gamma (3D) - Habitable Zone/M.E.G. camp, Pipe Dreams, Level 0.2, Locked, Electrical Station and Base Gamma; Level 2 now has a plywood-door crossing to Level 31.
places/level31 (3D; The Roller Rink) - dim warm rink in a 5 m shell, wood oval/barrier, starburst and disco ball, cinema, DJ booth and exits; zone dressers are listed in level31-parts.js.

places/level4, level5, level6, level7, level10, level26, level27 (3D) - Office, Hotel, drowned house, sea/Fort Surrender and deeper destinations; Level 5 guest rooms/suites are permanent player homes and Level 26 hosts SS Fun.

places/level11, level12, level13, places/testlab, places/spamton and other configured places (3D) - Infinite City and its generated streets, Matrix/Floor 283, authored tests and additional lore destinations.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer entry, camera/player setup, ordered behaviors and input mappings; config selects shared lighting.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - local configuration, authored placements and generated/ticked simulation.
scripts/main-menu.js + main-menu-ui.js + intake/tutorial scripts - title, creation, arrival, tutorial and Dina quest ticking/routing.
scripts/player.js + scripts/camera.js + scripts/view3.js - player state/actions, aiming camera and third-person toggle.
scripts/ui.js + scripts/stats-ui.js - composed player HUD/menus and character status panel; imports arcade and smoothie overlays and names Level 31 on transfers.
places/main/sim.js + scripts/lib/maze.js + scripts/lib/xmas-room.js - Level 0 layout, Christmas Area and stair-anomaly seeding.
places/level02/sim.js + scripts/lib/level02.js + scripts/lib/l02-grid.js + scripts/lib/remodel-quest.js - Level 0.2 house, crew exit, basement grid/collapse and Fresh Paint.
places/level31/sim.js + scripts/lib/level31.js + scripts/lib/level31-parts.js - versioned rink shell and modular zone dressing; scripts/player.js applies rink movement physics.
shared: scripts/lib/hub.js + scripts/lib/data/preload.yml + scripts/lib/preload-next.js - solo room IDs/names, destinations, home destinations and door/model proximity-preload manifest.
scripts/lib/loot.js + scripts/lib/items.js + scripts/lib/weapons.js/data/weapons.yml - common loot, containers, item definitions, rarity and weapon variants; items now include roller skates.

scripts/door-geo.js + scripts/lib/door-swing.js + scripts/lib/level3-hatch.js - parametric door geometry/motion and deterministic Level 3 paired wall-hatch layout; thresholds/sign geometry shared by participating places.

scripts/lib/quest-route.js + scripts/lib/quest-mark.js + scripts/lib/quests.js - crossing graph/objectives and common quest state; dialogue data authors conversations and npc-starters supplies quest/realty choices.
scripts/lib/data/l02-props.yml + scripts/lib/data/l02-remodel.yml + scripts/lib/l02-grid.js - Level 0.2 prop catalog, shifting partitions, lamp/paint configuration, crew dressing and reset.
scripts/lib/breakables.js + scripts/lib/data/breakables.yml - shared prop/wall material, damage, drops, wrecking and regrowth; place sims opt in with sweepProps/tickWalls.
scripts/lib/data/cow-lines.yml + scripts/lib/data/voice-cast.yml/voice-acted.yml + scripts/lib/voices.js - named performers and recorded takes for NPC bark/dialogue consumers.
scripts/lib/level31.js - shared rink bounds/zones, arrival/door IDs and skateStep movement model; consumed by Level 31 sim and player movement.
notableExports: scripts/lib/level31.js - H, B, RINK, ZONES, ARRIVE, DOOR, onRink, zoneAt, SKATE, skateStep; shared Level 31 plan and skating step.
scripts/lib/level31-parts.js - layParts; delegates to layArcade, layFood, layRental and layShop in separate modules (currently empty dressers).
scripts/lib/hub.js - HUB_ROOM, HUB_PLACE, isHubRoom, soloRoom, HOMES, LEVEL_NAMES, lastLevel, toHub, toSolo; kiosk destination can depend on player's booked room.
scripts/lib/items.js - itemsOf, tokenOf, describe, MEAT, CASH and money; shared item tokens now describe skates as weightless inventory.
scripts/lib/quest-route.js - nextQuestExit; Level 2 plywood-door and Level 31 return crossings are in its directed graph.
scripts/lib/quests.js - MAX_TRACK, TINT, PLACE_NAMES, qid, setQuest, endQuest, tracked, toggleTrack; PLACE_NAMES includes Level 31.
scripts/lib/level5.js - T, ZONES, OPENINGS, EXITS, ARRIVALS, ELEVATORS, BOILER, facing, zoneAt and hotel constants; adds per-room l5-home-* arrivals.
scripts/lib/stats.js - ATTRS, SKILLS, SKILL_KEYS, ATTR_MAX, START and attribute/skill helpers including pickupWeight (skates weight zero).
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment, needs, combat, access, appearance, saved position, tapes, currency and homeKeep build buckets; skates flag and slip notice live on player state.
scripts/lib/quests.js - player.state.quests, qtrack and qdone; scripts/lib/dina-quest.js advances dinaQ and owns dinaDiary/dcut/dinaLead plus legacy quest migration.
scripts/lib/remodel-quest.js - player.state.remodQ, l02got, l02paint, fresh, capnAsk and capnFailed plus Fresh Paint quest/HUD/payout/reputation.
scripts/build.js + places/level5/sim.js - player homeKeep.built or homeKeep.l5built; home11 and booked Level 5 room buckets reconstruct separately.
scripts/l5-resident.js + places/level5/sim.js - player l5room/l5home/l5until/l5key booking identity and place.state.l5rent permanent exclusive-room ledger.
scripts/arcade-play.js owns arcade session/score and arcadeBest; smoothie-player.js owns smoothieOpen/smix/smoothieBook/smoothieBuff/sCut; UI overlays consume these states.
Enemy managers own AI and sneakTarget; scripts/lib/meg-agent.js keeps gunpoint reaction memory/dialogue/pose on NPCs; scripts/lib/critter-model.js refits appearances.
places/level31/sim.js owns place.state.v31 layout version; scripts/player.js mover scratch owns transient slip cooldown/onRink state while player.state.skates persists the acquired skates.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered locomotion, player/foe, swim/climb, interact, grab/kick, build, inventory, combat, social, hub, camera and quest behaviors; arcade-play.js and smoothie-player.js join the behavior stack.

world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → camera; camera writes aimPt/aimPitch → player.js ballistics and weaponAim; player.js zoneHere → scripts/lib/maze.js zone names.
world.config.yaml input actions bind kick H/L and reload R; handlers in player/combat behaviors consume action names.

scripts/routing.js requested room → scripts/lib/hub.js solo room selection; toHub/toSolo cross to hub/home and maintain roomHop/save-place state; kiosk Level 5 home destination resolves to the resident's l5-home-<room> arrival.
Fresh visit → main-menu.js; START routes to intake or Bonus, wardrobe close to intro/tutorial0; menuOpen drives menu UI and solo pause scales place time.

tutorial0 HALOGEN cut completion → scripts/lib/tut0-cut.js and scripts/lib/dina-quest.js; diary/cutscene and clue records across Level 26, Level 1, Level 3 and Gamma advance player.state.dinaQ and play recorded voices.
scripts/build.js permits building only inside home11 or permanently booked Level 5 room; placement/removal writes homeKeep.built or homeKeep.l5built, and Level 5 sim restores saved pieces.
scripts/l5-resident.js booking → player l5home/l5room and place.state.l5rent permanent ledger; resident booking assigns room/trunk ownership.
Level 2 sim spawns l2-to-l31 → scripts/level-door.js transfers to level31#l31-from-l2; Level 31 l31-back transfers to level2#l2-from-l31; quest-route.js maps both trigger IDs as directed crossings.
Level 31 sim reads shared H/B/RINK/ZONES/DOOR, lays shell then layParts zone dressers once under place.state.v31; door back to Level 2 and the white Level 70 door is decorative/locked.
scripts/player.js movement on place level31 + onRink(x,z) → skateStep(SKATE, player.state.skates, mover scratch, input/velocity); shoes slip on turns and owned skates roll/glide/brake.

usable bc-cab-4 press → arcade.js ears.press sets player.state.arcade; arcade-play.js consumes movement/jump/interact and updates session.ap + arcadeBest → arcade-ui.js draws overlay; Squeeze Play similarly routes smoothie actions through smoothie-player.js.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus mall sims/shopper/salon scripts - authored mall shops/props and simulated staff; Block Panic and Squeeze Play are separate playable counters.

scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + build-piece.js + build.js + home reconstruction scripts - furniture-specific models/dimensions through common placement, persistence and rebuild flow; home11 and Level 5 use separate saved buckets.

scripts/door-geo.js + scripts/lib/door-swing.js and prop-interactions.js + interactive-props data + prop-part.js - parametric doors/storage parts with eased motion and legacy prop migration; Fort Surrender uses tagged paired leaves.
scripts/lib/thresholds.js + scripts/threshold-geo.js + participating place sims, alongside sign-style.js/sign-geo.js - shared crossing clues and per-place/per-id sign-board styles.
places/level01/sim.js + Zenith geometry, breach, hatch, bot and hazard scripts; places/level02/sim.js + l02-grid.js vary partitions/lights/crew/knocks/reset.
scripts/lib/meg-agent.js - per-NPC nerve/stats/weapon-driven reactions, aim, cover and recorded gunpoint barks; scripts/lib/critter-model.js refits appearances across Level 7, Bonus and Level 0.2.

Level 13 furnishing/dressing data and foe/people/tape layers vary rooms, story, encounters and residents; weapon data vary requirements/stats/loot while stats.js and weapon-look/fp-gun/vmpose supply handling and visuals.
Level 31 layout is shared through scripts/lib/level31.js; places/level31/sim.js builds common shell and rink then dispatches per-zone lay functions through scripts/lib/level31-parts.js.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - procedural balloon geometry exists, while Level 26 placements/barrage use uploaded models.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - marked temporary hair lane rig; no current references found.
art/critter-hair-tripo/fit.py.held - saved fitter copy; active fit.py is the documented build fitter.
scripts/dbg-pose.js - debug-room mannequin gallery after places/debug removal; no current placement found.
scripts/dbg-bodypad.js, scripts/debug-pad.js, scripts/lib/debug-layout.js - debug-room pads/layout after places/debug removal; no current references found.
migrationNotes: Level 31 sim uses place.state.v31=1 and removes prior root l31-* objects before laying; keep IDs prefixed l31- and match scripts/lib/level31.js geometry, zone coordinates and door IDs.

Skate ownership is player.state.skates and inventory token skates is weightless in items.js/stats.js; transient slipUntil/slipNext/onRink are mover scratch, and skating checks place level31 plus floor y and rink bounds.
Level 2's plywood-door dressing seeds once via place.state.l31V=1; its trigger targets level31#l31-from-l2 and return trigger targets level2#l2-from-l31. Keep trigger IDs aligned with quest-route.js.
Level 5 kiosk home arrivals are derived from OPENINGS for guest/suite rooms as l5-home-<room>; hub.js accepts a function destination and passes player state to resolve it.
Level 0.2 sim V=25 rebuilds generated roots; preserve phase/caseLandAt and debris tags, plus the 15-second empty reset. Grid state remains place.state.l02grid={layout, lamps}.
Dina quest stages remain in player.state.dinaQ; retain legacy the-undelivered migration, the-way-back quest ID, clue setDinaStep stages and exact recorded voice lines.
